data.value: One read-only bundle for Service Desk. Collection uses the current process permissions and does not start remediation, active network probes, or hidden elevation. Review the contents before sharing: account/SID data, process paths and command lines, IP addresses/ports, event text, device identifiers, and notes may be present.
